title: Surreal Cosmic Overseer
description: A surreal scene featuring a giant blue multi-armed goddess with flowing hair floating in a starry sky above a large stylized all-seeing eye containing a nuclear symbol. She holds a spear and a scythe while a ceiling fan spins above her. Below is a pastoral landscape with a wooden dock where a soldier in green uniform sits beside a vase of flowers, two red horses near a fence, a partial green face in the foreground, and a smoking industrial factory in the distance.
prompt: Surreal painting of a giant blue multi-armed Hindu-inspired goddess with flowing golden hair floating in a swirling cosmic sky filled with stars and nebulae. She holds a spear and scythe while hovering above a massive stylized purple eye containing a golden nuclear radiation symbol. A wooden ceiling fan spins above her head. In the foreground a green giant face appears on the left, two red horses stand near a wooden fence by a glowing circular pond, a soldier in green military uniform sits pensively on a wooden dock beside a vase of colorful flowers, with a smoking industrial factory in the distant background under a twilight sky.
